location.address: 2300 Hallock-Young Road and 2823 Ellsworth Bailey Road, Lordstown, OH 44481

status_as_of_cutoff: site work-construction: Lordstown Planning Commission minutes show final site plan approval on 2025-09-16 for the Foxconn Lordstown facility expansion, including three building expansions, a new POC modular building, and concrete-pad renovation for AI server components and data-center infrastructure. OpenAI announced Lordstown on 2025-09-23 as a Stargate AI data center site developed through SoftBank/OpenAI, and local reporting documented preparation/site work by 2025-10-27. However, local officials/Foxconn characterized the on-site POC as engineering/design/showroom use rather than a working data center, and Lordstown extended a moratorium on new data-center permits effective 2026-07-05. No energization, certificate of occupancy, or operational IT-load evidence was located.
evidence_grade: B+: official Lordstown Planning Commission minutes verify site-plan approval and project scope; OpenAI verifies Stargate site selection and SoftBank/OpenAI role; local reporting verifies site-preparation work and ownership transfer. Capacity allocation and whether the Lordstown POC is a functional data center remain unresolved.

actions.summary: Final site plan review for Foxconn Lordstown facility expansion at 2300 Hallock Young Road and 2823 Ellsworth Bailey Road; scope includes three building expansions, a POC modular building, and concrete-pad renovation for manufacturing AI server components and data-center infrastructure.

OpenAI announced Lordstown, Ohio as one of two SoftBank/OpenAI Stargate sites that together can scale to 1.5 GW over the next 18 months; OpenAI said SoftBank had broken ground on an advanced data center design in Lordstown expected to be operational in 2026.

Local reporting observed crews clearing space, removing parking-lot pavement, and dismantling a solar array for a proof-of-concept AI data center near the northwest/front portion of the former GM/Foxconn plant.

Ordinance 1-2026 imposed a temporary moratorium, not to exceed 180 days, on granting/issuing new permits and receiving/processing applications for proposed data centers within the Village of Lordstown.
Ordinance 29-2026 extended the temporary moratorium on new data-center permits/applications for another period not to exceed 180 days; local reporting says the extension is effective July 5, 2026.
